Defeat Drednaw]]'' }} |} '''Milo''' (Japanese: '''ヤロー''' ''Yarrow'') is a {{wp|farmer}} who is the [[Gym Leader]] of [[Turffield]]'s [[Gym]], known officially as [[Turffield Stadium]]. He [[Type expert|specializes]] in {{type|Grass}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. He gives the {{badge|Grass}} to Trainers who defeat him. ==In the core series games== Milo is the first Gym Leader [[Galar]]ian {{pkmn|Trainer}}s face in their [[Galar League|Gym Challenge]]. He is a farmer that honed his skills working on his farm with his Pokémon, and can be often seen in [[Turffield]] trying to wrangle wandering {{p|Wooloo}} with his farm's herding {{p|Yamper}}. Despite his size and strength, Milo is a gentle, laid-back Trainer who has trouble giving it his all on weaker opponents and doesn't worry about winning or losing so long as each party is having fun. [[Nessa]] considers Milo her [[rival]], as revealed in her [[League Card]], but Milo doesn't seem to acknowledge this, claiming the only rival he has is himself. Milo is first seen at [[Motostoke Stadium]] for the Gym Challenge's opening ceremony. The {{player}} first meets him at {{rt|4|Galar}}, chasing after one of the {{p|Wooloo}} used in his Gym Mission. Once the player has defeated [[Kabu]], Milo travels to [[Motostoke]] alongside [[Nessa]] to congratulate the player and [[Hop]] on defeating the first three Gyms and wish them good luck with the rest of the Gym Challenge. At the Champion Cup in [[Wyndon]], Milo is pitted against [[Raihan]] in the first round and loses. He also participates in the post-game [[Wyndon Stadium/Champion tournaments|Champion tournaments]] and the [[Galarian Star Tournament]]. After Milo's initial defeat, the player is awarded with the {{badge|Grass}}, {{TM|10|Magical Leaf}}, and the [[List of clothing in Pokémon Sword and Shield|Grass Uniform]]. ===League Cards=== This is a transcript of the back of Milo's [[League Card]]s in {{g|Sword and Shield}}. ;Normal League Card :"This {{pkmn|Trainer}} was born as the son of farmers. He has honed his strength, stamina, and skill as a Pokémon Trainer from a young age by working together with his Pokémon. Because of his gentle nature, he has trouble going all out on weaker opponents, which is why his [[Gym]] is the first one for challengers to attempt during the [[Galar League|Gym Challenge]]. He always wears his boots, as apparently they let him dig in his heels when he needs to." ;Rare League Card :"Though his record isn't the best due to his focus on simply having fun in battles, Milo himself is incredibly strong. The rolls of hay used in his Gym Challenge each weigh over {{tt|770 pounds|350 kilograms}}, yet Milo can roll them around easily. {{p|Wooloo}} tend to roll around, too, and sometimes they can get carried away and roll out of the [[Turffield Stadium|Gym Stadium]]. It has become common in [[Turffield]] to see the whole town chasing after Milo, who is in turn chasing after a stray Wooloo, along with {{p|Yamper}}." ===Pokémon=== Milo keeps his Pokémon in [[Ultra {{color2|000|Pokémon Sword and Shield|Sword and Shield}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Milo/Quotes}} ==In animation== [[File:Milo Twilight Wings.png|thumb|250px|Milo in [[Pokémon: Twilight Wings]]]] ===Pokémon: Twilight Wings=== Milo made a cameo appearance in ''[[TW01|Letter]]''. Milo briefly appeared in ''[[TW03|Buddy]]'', where [[Hop]]'s {{p|Wooloo}} landed on his farm after running away from its Trainer. He was alerted to its presence by his herd of Wooloo. Upon seeing its tag, Milo arranged for a [[Flying Taxi]] to come and take Hop's Wooloo home. In ''[[TW04|Early-Evening Waves]]'', Milo was seen on television defeating [[Nessa]] during the [[Galar League|Champions Cup]]. In ''[[TW07|Sky]]'', Milo gave his thoughts about the Champion [[Leon]] in an interview. In ''[[TW08|The Gathering of Stars]]'', Milo was seen rolling up some hay on the field with his Wooloo. He was later seen at [[Wyndon Stadium]], walking out onto the field for the opening ceremony of the [[Galarian Star Tournament]]. ====Pokémon==== =====On hand===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Milo |pkmn=Eldegoss |type1=Grass |img=830Eldegoss.png |epnum=TW04 |epname=Early-Evening Waves |desc=During the narration of his [[Galar League|Champions Cup]] {{pkmn|battle}} against [[Nessa]], it was revealed that Milo had used his {{p|Eldegoss}} against Nessa's Drednaw. None of Wooloo's moves are known.}} ===GOTCHA!=== Milo briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the manga== [[File:Milo Adventures.png|thumb|220px|Milo in Pokémon Adventures]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== Milo debuted in ''[[PASS03|Chomp!! Defeat Drednaw]]''. He, along with various other Gym Leaders, was first seen reacting to the news that [[Leon]] had endorsed two {{pkmn|Trainer}}s for the [[Galar League|Gym Challenge]]. In ''[[PASS06|Watch Out!! Strong Rivals]]'', Milo faced {{Henry}}, {{Casey}}, [[Hop]], [[Bede]], and [[Marnie]] in a series of Gym battles at [[Turffield Stadium]] and lost. Later, he, [[Nessa]], and [[Kabu]] personally congratulated Casey and Hop for completing the first three Galar Gyms. In ''[[PASS25|Rumble!! The Horrific Darkest Day]]'', the Galar Gym Leaders gathered at [[Rose Tower]] to find out if [[Rose]] intended on bringing harm to the region. While [[Oleana]] kept the Gym Leaders busy, Henry, Casey, Bede, Hop, and Marnie went up to meet Rose, only find he was elsewhere. On a video screen, Rose announced his intention to restart the [[Darkest Day]] and ensure the safety of Galar's future. Power Spot lights began appearing all over the region, causing Pokémon to start [[Dynamax]]ing at random. While some traveled to confront Rose at the [[Hammerlocke]] [[Energy Plant]], Milo went back to Turffield to help deal with the rampaging Dynamax Pokémon. In ''[[PASS29|GRRR!! The Irrepairable Gears]]'', Macro Cosmos employees were dispatched to deal with the Dynamax Pokémon, allowing Milo's group to provide backup for the others against {{p|Eternatus}}. By the time they arrived, Milo's group found Eternatus had fled, leaving those who battled it unconscious and covered in its poison. The injured were taken to a hospital to recover. By ''[[PASS40|Rumble!! The Darkest Day Returns]]'', the others had fully recovered from Eternatus's poison and were discharged from the hospital.
